description: This file defines the SchedulingOptions class, which encapsulates configurable options related to scheduler behavior in the Orleans runtime. It includes parameters such as delay warning thresholds, activation scheduling quantum, turn warning length, pending work item limits, and warning intervals.

classes.name: SchedulingOptions
classes.description: Options class for configuring scheduler behavior in Orleans, including thresholds and limits for work item scheduling and execution.

methods.name: SchedulingOptions.DelayWarningThreshold
methods.description: Gets or sets the delay threshold for enqueued work items to trigger a warning.

methods.name: SchedulingOptions.ActivationSchedulingQuantum
methods.description: Gets or sets the time quantum for activation micro-turns, acting as a soft time limit.

methods.name: SchedulingOptions.TurnWarningLengthThreshold
methods.description: Gets or sets the threshold for CPU execution time in micro-turns to generate warnings.

methods.name: SchedulingOptions.MaxPendingWorkItemsSoftLimit
methods.description: Gets or sets the soft limit on the number of queued work items before warnings are generated.

methods.name: SchedulingOptions.StoppedActivationWarningInterval
methods.description: Gets or sets the interval after which to log errors for tasks scheduled to stopped activations.
